name: ActionHasRange

description: Changes the current action button set to CURRENT_ACTIONBAR_PAGE. - TODO wiki conflicts for 1.12: may or may not have a parameter. - Notifies the UI that the current action button set has been updated to the current value of the CURRENT_ACTIONBAR_PAGE global variable. - Will cause an ACTIONBAR_PAGE_CHANGED event to fire only if there was actually a change.

name: GetActionCooldown
description: This returns the cooldown values of the specified action.

returns.name: start
returns.description: The time at which the current cooldown period began (relative to the result of GetTime), or 0 if the cooldown is not active or not applicable.

returns.name: duration
returns.description: The duration of the current cooldown period in seconds, or 0 if the cooldown is not active or not applicable.

returns.name: enable
returns.description: Indicate if cooldown is enabled. Returns greater than 0 if a cooldown is active, and 0 if a cooldown cannot be active. This lets you know when a shapeshifting form has ended and the actual countdown has started.

name: GetActionCount
description: Get the count (bandage/potion/etc) for an action. - Returns 0 if the action has no count or if the specified action slot is empty. - The action's count as displayed on the action's icon; ex. for a potion action, returns the number of potions left.

name: GetActionText
description: Get the text label (macros, etc) for an action, returns nil if none. - nil if the slot has no action text, or is empty. - Macro actions use their names for their action text. - Most standard WoW action icons don't have action text.

name: GetActionTexture
description: Get filepath for an action's texture, i.e. icon image. - Returns nil if the slot is empty.

name: GetBonusBarOffset
description: Determine which page of bonus actions to show. - Warrior - Battle Stance: 1 - Defensive Stance: 2 - Berserker Stance: 3 - Druid - Caster: 0 - Cat: 1 - Tree of Life: 2 - Bear: 3 - Moonkin: 4 - Rogue - Normal: 0 - Stealthed: 1 - Priest - Normal: 0 - Shadowform: 1

name: IsAutoRepeatAction
description: Return 1 if an action is auto-repeating, nil otherwise.

name: IsCurrentAction

name: IsUsableAction

name: IsConsumableAction

name: IsEquippedAction
description: Return 1 if an action is equipped (i.e. connected to an item that must be equipped), nil otherwise.

name: PickupAction
description: Drags an action out of the specified quickbar slot and holds it on the cursor.

name: PlaceAction
description: Drops an action from the cursor into the specified quickbar slot. - IMPORTANT: You can crash your client if you send an invalid slot number.

name: SetActionBarToggles
description:
Set show toggle for each action bar.
This doesn't actually change the action bar states directly, it simply registers the desired states for the next time the game is loaded. The states during play are in the variables SHOW_MULTI_ACTIONBAR_1, SHOW_MULTI_ACTIONBAR_2, SHOW_MULTI_ACTIONBAR_3, SHOW_MULTI_ACTIONBAR_4, and reflected by calling MultiActionBar_Update().

params.name: bottomRight

params.name: sideRight
params.description: 1 if the first (outer) right side action bar is to be shown, 0 or nil otherwise.

name: ForceQuit
description: Instantly quits the game, bypassing the usual 20 seconds countdown. Your character will not be logged out when using this function. name: TargetByName
description:
Selects the specified player as the current target.
EXAMPLE given a blue dragon and a player named "Greenknight"
- Using nil:
/run TargetByName("Blue Dragon", nil)
/run TargetByName("Green Dragon", nil)
/run DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(UnitName("target"))
// outputs "Greenknight", as "Green Dragon" fuzzy-targets the player
- Using 1:
/run TargetByName("Blue Dragon", 1)
/run TargetByName("Green Dragon", 1)
/run DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(UnitName("target"))
// outputs "Blue Dragon"

name: CollapseTradeSkillSubClass
description: Collapses a trade skill header in the trade skill window. - Collapses all headers if index is 0. - Trade skill window must be open.

name: ExpandTradeSkillSubClass

name: GetNumTradeSkills
description: Returns the number of trade skill entries (including headers). - Trade skill window must be open.

name: GetTradeSkillInfo
description: Retrieves information about a specific trade skill entry. - Trade skill window must be open.

returns.description: The name of the skill or header.

returns.name: skillType
returns.description: "header", "trivial", "easy", "medium", "optimal", or "difficult".

returns.name: numAvailable

name: GetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter

name: GetTradeSkillInvSlots

name: GetTradeSkillLine

returns.description: Name of the current trade skill.

returns.name: level

returns.name: maxLevel

name: GetTradeSkillSubClasses

name: GetTradeSkillSubClassFilter

name: SetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter

name: SetTradeSkillSubClassFilter
description: Sets the subclass filter. - Trade skill window must be open.

name: GetNumTrainerServices

name: IsTradeskillTrainer

name: SetTrainerServiceTypeFilter

name: AssistUnit
description: Instructs your character to assist the specified unit.

name: DropItemOnUnit
description: Drops an item from the cursor onto a unit.

name: FollowUnit
description: Follow an ally with the specified UnitID

name: StartDuelUnit
description: Challenge a unit to a duel.

name: UnitAffectingCombat
description: Determine if the unit is in combat or has aggro. - Returns nil if the unit being checked for aggro is out of range. - Returns nil if a unit is proximity-aggroed. It wont return 1 until it either attacks or is attacked. - For hunters, returns 1 shortly after pet enters combat.

name: UnitArmor
description: Returns the armor statistics relevant to the specified unit.

returns.name: base
returns.description: Base armor without buffs, armor kits or enchantments.

returns.name: effective
returns.description: Effective/total armor after modifiers.

returns.name: armor
returns.description: Armor after adding armor kits and enchantments but without buffs.

returns.name: bonus
returns.description: Amount of armor increase due to positive buffs.

returns.name: malus
returns.description: Armor reduction due to negative buffs (a negative number).

name: UnitAttackBothHands
description: Returns information about the unit's melee attacks.

returns.name: mainBase
returns.description: The unit's base main hand attack power.

returns.name: mainMod
returns.description: Any modifier to the unit's main hand attack power.

returns.name: offBase
returns.description: The unit's base offhand attack power (equal to unarmed weapon skill if unit doesn't dual wield).

returns.name: offMod
returns.description: Any modifier to the unit's offhand attack power.

name: UnitAttackPower
description: Returns the unit's melee attack power and modifiers.

returns.name: base
returns.description: The unit's base attack power.

returns.name: bonus
returns.description: The total effect of positive buffs to attack power.

returns.name: malus
returns.description: The total effect of negative buffs to the attack power (a negative number).

name: UnitAttackSpeed
description: Returns the unit's melee attack speed for each hand.

returns.name: mainSpeed
returns.description: The unit's base main hand attack speed (seconds).

returns.name: offSpeed
returns.description: The unit's offhand attack speed (seconds) - nil if the unit has no offhand weapon.

name: UnitCanAssist
description: Returns 1 if the first unit can assist the second, nil otherwise.

name: UnitCanAttack
description: Returns 1 if the first unit can attack the second, nil otherwise.

name: UnitCanCooperate
description: Returns 1 if the first unit can cooperate with the second, nil otherwise.

name: UnitCharacterPoints
description: Returns the number of unspent talent points for the specified unit -- usually 0.

name: UnitClass
description: Defaults to WARRIOR if unit has no class

returns.name: classLocalized
returns.description: ex. "Mage", "Warrior", "Guerrier"

name: UnitClassification
description: Returns the classification of the specified unit (ex. "elite" or "worldboss").

name: UnitCreatureFamily
description: Returns the type of creature of the specified unit (ex. "Crab"). - TODO this can probably return nil

name: UnitCreatureType
description: Returns the classification type of creature of the specified unit (ex. "Beast").

name: UnitDamage
description: Returns the damage statistics relevant to the specified unit.

returns.name: lowDmg
returns.description: The unit's minimum melee damage.

returns.name: hiDmg
returns.description: The unit's maximum melee damage.

returns.name: offlowDmg
returns.description: The unit's minimum offhand melee damage.

returns.name: offhiDmg
returns.description: The unit's maximum offhand melee damage.

returns.name: bonus
returns.description: Positive physical Bonus (should be >= 0).

returns.name: malus
returns.description: Negative physical Bonus (should be <= 0).

returns.name: percentmod
returns.description: Percentage modifier (usually 1).

name: UnitDefense
description: Returns the base defense skill of the specified unit.

returns.name: baseDefense
returns.description: The unit's defense without armor. Includes the warrior talent Anticipation.

returns.name: armorDefense
returns.description: The defense gained from the unit's armor.

name: UnitExists
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit exists, nil otherwise.

name: UnitFactionGroup
description: Returns the faction group id and name of the specified unit.

name: UnitHealth
description: Returns the current health, in points, of the specified unit.

name: UnitHealthMax
description: Returns the maximum health, in points, of the specified unit.

name: UnitIsCharmed
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is charmed, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsCivilian
description: Returns 1 if the unit is a civilian NPC.

name: UnitIsConnected
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is connected or npc, nil if offline or not a valid unit.

name: UnitIsCorpse
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is a corpse, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsDead
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is dead, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsDeadOrGhost
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is dead or a ghost, nil otherwise. - Returns 1 while Feign Death active.

name: UnitIsEnemy
description: Returns 1 if the specified units are enemies, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsFriend
description: Returns 1 if the specified units are friends (PC of same faction or friendly NPC), nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsGhost
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is a ghost, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsPVP
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is flagged for PVP, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsPVPFreeForAll
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is flagged for free-for-all PVP, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsPlayer
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is a player character, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsPlusMob
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is a mob, more powerful than its nominal level, nil otherwise (ex. "elite" mobs)

name: UnitIsTapped
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is tapped, nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsTappedByPlayer
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is tapped by the player himself, otherwise nil.

name: UnitIsTrivial
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is trivial (Trivial means the unit is "grey" to the player), nil otherwise.

name: UnitIsUnit
description: Determine if two units are the same unit.

name: UnitIsVisible
description: 1 if visible, nil if not

name: UnitLevel
description: Returns the level of a unit. - Returns -1 if unknown or boss. - When inebriated, the apparent level of hostile units is lowered by up to 5. - When calling UnitLevel("player") on PLAYER_LEVEL_UP it might be incorrect; check the payload instead to be sure.

description: Returns the current mana (or energy,rage,etc), in points, of the specified unit. - TODO what if the target has no mana bar? Is it 0?

name: UnitManaMax
description: Returns the maximum mana (or energy,rage,etc), in points, of the specified unit. - TODO what if the target has no mana bar? Is it 0?

name: UnitName
description: Returns the name (and realm name) of a unit.

name: UnitOnTaxi
description: Returns 1 if unit is on a taxi.

name: UnitPlayerControlled
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit is controlled by a player, nil otherwise.

name: UnitPlayerOrPetInParty
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit/pet is a member of the player's party, nil otherwise (returns 1 for "player" and "pet").

name: UnitPlayerOrPetInRaid
description: Returns 1 if the specified unit/pet is a member of the player's raid, nil otherwise (returns 1 for "player" and "pet").

name: UnitPVPName
description: Returns unit's name with PvP rank prefix (ex. "Corporal Allianceguy"). - nil if out of range

name: UnitPVPRank
description: Get PvP rank information for requested unit. - Starts at 5, not 1. Returns 0 if no rank.

name: UnitPowerType
description: Returns a number corresponding to the power type (ex. mana, rage or energy) of the specified unit. - TODO what if no power type? Can this return nil?

name: UnitRace
description: Returns the race name of the specified unit (ex. "Human" or "Troll"). - TODO can this return nil? - "Undead" localized returns "Scourge" English

returns.name: base

returns.name: modifier

description: Returns the ranged attack power of the unit.

returns.name: bonus
returns.description: The total effect of positive buffs to ranged attack power..

description: Returns a number corresponding to the reaction (aggressive, neutral or friendly) of the first unit towards the second unit. - Values other than 2, 4 or 5 are only returned when the first unit is an NPC in a reputation faction and the second is you or your pet.

returns.name: reaction

returns.name: bonus

returns.name: malus

returns.name: bonus

returns.name: malus

name: UnitXP
